youtube_description:
X5Learn provides users with a number of educational tools for interacting with online open educational resources (OER). OERs are openly licensed learning/ teaching/ research materials that are available free for public use. 
X5Learn consists of two components, i) an index that catalogues over 120,000 OERs that are scattered all over the Internet and ii) a learning platform that is powered by multiple AI components such as search, recommendation, intelligent previewing and cross-lingual translation.
